summary: A monthly report of ARPANET traffic for August 1973. It tabulates, for each Host, how many packets it sent, split between traffic that stayed within its own node and traffic sent to other nodes, with daily averages. It is a data memo and defines no protocol.

plainLanguage.summary: This report counts packets sent by ARPANET hosts during August 1973. It separates traffic between nodes from traffic within a node and gives daily averages.

subtitle: BBN's table of packets output by ARPANET hosts during August 1973.

tldr.problem: Network participants wanted a month-by-month record of traffic sent by ARPANET hosts.
tldr.mechanism: The report lists output packets per host, separates inter-node and intra-node counts, and adds site and network totals.
tldr.outcome: It records 99,009,940 inter-node packets for August. The unit metadata says RFC 579 updates this report.

today: The unit metadata says RFC 566 is updated by RFC 579. This document is a historical traffic report rather than a protocol specification.

sections.title: August Host Throughput
sections.content: RFC 566 attaches host traffic statistics for August 1973. Its table is titled Host Throughput Summary (Packets Output). The header says this RFC updates RFC 556.
sections.plainLanguage: This is a monthly report of packets sent by network hosts. It covers all 31 days of August.

sections.title: What Each Row Counts
sections.content: The table gives inter-node packets, intra-node packets, and the total for each host. Where a site has several hosts, it also gives a site subtotal, an average daily inter-node count, and the number of days counted. BELV, ABER and LBL are listed as having no traffic.
sections.plainLanguage: Each row separates packets sent between nodes from packets sent within one node. Site totals combine the hosts listed at that site.

sections.title: Monthly Network Totals
sections.content:
The network totals are 99,009,940 inter-node packets and 37,732,470 intra-node packets. Daily averages are 3,193,869 and 1,217,177 respectively, and the average per node-day is 86,321 and 31,897.

The report gives 1.07 as the inter-node packets-per-message figure. Among the listed hosts, ISI Host 1 has the largest inter-node count, 14,683,780.
sections.plainLanguage: The report adds the host counts to show traffic for the full network. It also gives daily averages and a packets-per-message figure.

references.text: RFC 556, the earlier traffic statistics report named in this RFC's header.
